title: RichTextLabel/RichTextEffect rendering suboptimal compared to _draw() due to pixel snapping.
body:
### Tested versions

- v4.6.dev4.official [bd2ca13c6]
(I've noticed this problem in most previous version of Godot.)

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev4 - Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon R9 200 Series (radeonsi, pitcairn, ACO, DRM 3.57, 6.8.0-90-generic) - AMD FX(tm)-6300 Six-Core Processor (6 threads) - 15.52 GiB memory

### Issue description

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/89784685-2804-46ee-a8db-d3e5e433c4d0

When using `RichTextLabel` + `RichTextEffect` adjusting the origin leads to snappy pixels even when `snap_controls_to_pixels = false`. Both `CharFXTransform.origin` and `CharFXTransform.transform.origin` have the problem.

```gdscript
# richtexteffect
func _process_custom_fx(char_fx: CharFXTransform) -> bool:
	char_fx.offset.y = sin(Time.get_ticks_msec() * .0025 + char_fx.relative_index) * 2
	return true
```

But if using `draw_set_transform()` in `func _draw()` you can get the ideal silky smooth transform.

```gdscript
# node2d
func _draw() -> void:
	for i in text.length():
		var character := text[i]
		var char_pos = Vector2(x_offset, sin(Time.get_ticks_msec() * .0025 + i) * 2 + font_size * 1.5)
		draw_set_transform(char_pos)
		draw_string(font, Vector2.ZERO, character, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size, Color.WHITE)
		x_offset += font.get_string_size(character, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, font_size).x
```

### Steps to reproduce

N/A
